axes.rationale: Declaration order sets the frame slots (tileX at [bp-6], count at [bp-8], tileY at [bp-0xa])

axes.name: body
axes.rationale: Named column/row variables and loop spelling change what the loop optimizer hoists or strength-reduces

spec.semantic_summary: Batch: column as a named variable with inline row sums, both named, 0..3 loops with -1 offset, and continue-style bounds rejection, x two declaration orders
binding_evidence: Candidate declarations and source comments; inspect packet bindings before acceptance
